core_obligations: The author computes the linearized triangular-lattice dynamics in a Bargmann basis and diagonalizes its convolution symbol. Theta-function estimates control the quadratic zero of the dispersion and singular spectral projectors; weighted cancellations yield uniformL2 bounds and degenerate oscillatory-integral estimates produce the optimal t to minus one-third decay.
